info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Service Registry API
Atlassian Retrieve The Attributes Of Service Registries

params.name: serviceIds
params.description: The ID of the services (the strings starting with "b:" need to be decoded in Base64).

items.docs:
Retrieve the attributes of given service registries.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect apps can make this request and the servicesIds belong to the tenant you are requesting
